home.title: Ferrouswheel | Custom Metal Gifts in Bangalore — Nameplates, Keychains, Medal Hangers
home.description: Ferrouswheel makes personalised metal gifts in Bangalore: custom nameplates, keychains, bookmarks, medal hangers, wall clocks, necklaces & fandom decor. Laser-cut in steel, brass & copper. Pan-India delivery. Order on WhatsApp.

categories.title: Custom Metal Bookmarks with Your Name | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Personalised laser-cut metal bookmarks in steel, brass & copper — cricket, football, books, your name. Made in Bangalore, shipped pan-India. Great return gifts. Order on WhatsApp.
intro: A bookmark they'll actually keep. We laser-cut each one from steel, brass or copper in our Bommasandra workshop, shaped around whatever the reader loves — a cricket bat, a football, a favourite character — with their name cut right in.
Bookmarks are our go-to for return gifts, book-club gifts and school prize days: light to ship, tough enough to survive a school bag, and fully custom even in small batches.

categories.title: Custom Metal Keychains — Name, Car, Sports & Hobby | Ferrouswheel
categories.description: Personalised metal keychains laser-cut in Bangalore — car and bike silhouettes, sports, gym, music, names and initials. Steel, brass or copper. Pan-India delivery. Order on WhatsApp.
intro: No one likes boring keys. Send us the thing they're obsessed with — their car, their bike, their sport, their gym era — and we'll cut it in metal with their name on it.
Every keychain is designed for you first, previewed on WhatsApp, then laser-cut in-house. Ordering a set for a team, club or office? We do batches too.

categories.title: Custom Metal Name Plates for Home, Room & Desk | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Personalised metal nameplates handcrafted in Bangalore — family name plates for the door, kids' room signs and desk plates themed on tennis, cars, sneakers and more. Pan-India delivery.
intro: A subtle way to claim your territory. Our nameplates pair a name with the thing that makes it yours — a tennis racquet, a sneaker, a car, a guitar — laser-cut from stainless steel, brass, copper or mild steel.
Made for front doors, kids' rooms, home offices and desks. Tell us where it's going and we'll size it to suit.

categories.title: Custom Medal Hangers & Medal Display Racks | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Personalised metal medal hangers for runners, cricketers, swimmers, footballers and school athletes. Your name and sport, laser-cut in Bangalore. Bulk orders for schools and clubs. Pan-India delivery.
intro: Medals deserve better than a drawer. Our medal hangers put every win on the wall — shaped around your sport, with your name cut in, built strong enough for a growing collection.
Popular with runners, cricketers, swimmers and young athletes — and with schools and clubs ordering for whole teams before Sports Day.

categories.title: Custom Metal Name Necklaces & Pendants | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Fun personalised metal necklaces and pendants — names, initials, hobbies and inside jokes, laser-cut in steel, brass or copper in Bangalore. Pan-India delivery. Order on WhatsApp.
intro: Made to turn heads and spark laughs. Wear a name, an initial, a hobby or an inside joke — designed with you, then cut in metal.
A personal gift that doesn't look like everyone else's: birthdays, best friends, anniversaries.

categories.title: Custom Metal Wall Clocks — Sports & Hobby Themed | Ferrouswheel
categories.description: Personalised metal wall clocks where your sport or hobby replaces the numbers — football, cricket, cars, music and more. Handcrafted in Bangalore, delivered pan-India.
intro: Watching time pass can be fun. On our clocks, your favourite sport or hobby replaces the numbers — so the wall says something about you, not just the time.
A statement piece for a bedroom, a games room or the office, and a gift that gets looked at every single day.

categories.title: Handcrafted Metal Scale Models — Bikes & Cars | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Handcrafted metal scale models and table stands of bikes, cars and anything with wheels, made in our Bangalore workshop. Custom builds for riders, collectors and gifts.
intro: Smooth rides and cool looks. We build metal models of bikes, cars and anything with wheels and soul — including desk and table stands of your own ride.
Ferrouswheel started with a home-built go-kart, so these are close to our hearts. Send photos of the machine and we'll take it from there.

categories.title: Fandom Metal Wall Art & Decor | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Custom metal wall art for fans — sci-fi, superheroes, motorsport, anime and gaming inspired pieces, laser-cut in Bangalore. Personalised and shipped pan-India.
intro: For the fans who want it in metal. Bring us the movie, show, game or sport you live for and we'll design a piece of wall art around it.
Room makeovers, gaming setups and gifts for the friend who has already seen it twelve times.
